chunks.chunk_id: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)-001
chunks.source_document: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
chunks.source_name: Ministry of MSME & SIDBI, Government of India
chunks.text: CGTMSE was set up jointly by the Ministry of MSME and SIDBI to provide institutional credit guarantees to Member Lending Institutions (Banks, NBFCs, RRBs) so they can sanction collateral-free and third-party-guarantee-free credit facilities to new and existing Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs).

chunks.chunk_id: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)-002
chunks.source_document: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
chunks.source_name: Ministry of MSME & SIDBI, Government of India
chunks.text: The scheme provides credit guarantee coverage up to Rs. 500 Lakhs (Rs. 5 Crore) per eligible MSE borrower. Both term loans and working capital credit facilities are covered under the guarantee.

chunks.chunk_id: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)-003
chunks.section: Extent of Guarantee Coverage by Category
chunks.source_document: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
chunks.source_name: Ministry of MSME & SIDBI, Government of India
chunks.text: For Micro Enterprises: Up to 85% guarantee coverage for loans up to Rs. 5 Lakhs. For loans above Rs. 5 Lakhs up to Rs. 500 Lakhs, guarantee coverage is 75%. For Women Entrepreneurs & SC/ST Entrepreneurs: Guarantee coverage is enhanced up to 85% across all loan sizes up to Rs. 500 Lakhs. For Units in North Eastern Region (NER), Jammu & Kashmir, Ladakh, and Aspirational Districts: Guarantee coverage is up to 85%.

chunks.chunk_id: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)-004
chunks.source_document: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
chunks.source_name: Ministry of MSME & SIDBI, Government of India
chunks.text: An Annual Guarantee Fee (AGF) starting from as low as 0.37% per annum is charged based on the loan size and borrower risk profile. For loans up to Rs. 1 Crore, the fee is reduced to make credit affordable for micro-enterprises.
